responsibility: Lowers HIR block-like expressions into GCC block and conditional statement trees. It creates lexical scopes with local declarations from resolver ribs, compiles contained statements and trailing expressions into block bodies, stores expression results through an optional result temporary, and builds if/else forms—including chained else-if lowering—using backend block and if-statement hooks inside the current function context.
same_name_distinction: Implements block and if/else lowering behavior: it creates backend blocks, looks up resolver ribs for locals, compiles contained statements and trailing expressions, and builds conditional statement trees. Unlike the header, this file contains the actual visitor bodies and backend calls rather than just the block-oriented entry points and class declarations.
